name: Mango Lassi
steps: Wash and peel ripe mangoes, remove the stones and measure the edible flesh. Chop into pieces small enough for the blender; fibrous or underripe fruit gives a less smooth result.
Add mango, plain curd, milk and cardamom to the blender. Blend until smooth, stopping to scrape the sides if pieces of fruit remain.
Taste before adding sugar, since ripe mangoes may need very little. Add only as much of the measured sugar as needed and blend briefly to dissolve it.
Check the consistency: the lassi should be thick but pourable. Add a little more milk only if needed, then pour into glasses and serve chilled.
If preparing ahead, keep covered in the refrigerator. Stir gently before serving if the mixture separates.
tips: Use ripe sweet mangoes; sugar can be reduced or omitted.
substitutions: Any substitution changes the recipe: recheck allergies, Jain rules and quantities.
notes: Ingredient costs are estimates. Check local prices before shopping.
